name: sanctum
description: Sanctum — MPC-style touch drum machine (PWA prototype)

scripts.preview:https: npm run build && HTTPS=1 vite preview --host --port 4173
scripts.bridge:setup: cd bridge && npm install && bash native/build.sh
scripts.build:android: SANCTUM_TARGET=android npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build:android && cd android && ./gradlew clean assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build:android && cd android && ./gradlew clean assembleRelease
